dimensions.assessment: Directly involves the Department of Commerce and Congress, with indirect informational effects on manufacturers and critical infrastructure sectors.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary of Commerce shall conduct a study to identify, within each critical infrastructure sector, any product that is in high demand

dimensions.assessment: Requires an analytical study and report without changing regulatory requirements or compelling private information.
dimensions.evidence: This section may not be construed to provide the Secretary of Commerce with authority to compel a person to provide information

dimensions.assessment: Involves administrative costs of conducting a federal study, but no specific appropriation is stated.
Applies a reporting and study mandate across the 16 designated critical infrastructure sectors.
dimensions.evidence: the term 'critical infrastructure sector' means each of the 16 designated critical infrastructure sectors identified in Presidential Policy Directive 21

dimensions.assessment: Mandates a one-time study and report due within 18 months of enactment.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 18 months after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary shall submit to Congress a report

missing_information: Cost estimates for conducting the study and preparing the report
importance_detail.rationale: Directs the Department of Commerce to conduct a study and report on high-demand imported products in critical infrastructure sectors and the feasibility of manufacturing them domestically.
